Great to speak earlier — quick written recap so we have a single thread to track approvals and next steps. Key points I captured from today’s discovery call: 

- Primary use case: inference for nightly batch scoring + weekend peak support (high token volume but predictable windows)
- Target go-live: pilot in Q3, full rollout in Q4 if pilot meets latency and cost goals
- Initial model variant: 13B quantized (your infra team wanted a perf profile)

As discussed, two items I need to clarify to proceed with a formal SOW/quote:
1) Who owns the CapEx/renewal approval for this project (title + email)? Is procurement the path or does finance (CapEx) sign?
2) Who should we include on the procurement onboarding call to clear security docs (SOC2 / data retention), and what cadence works for your team next week?

I’ve attached a short draft SOW and the call recording. I’ll loop in pricing and procurement enablement internally once you confirm the approval owner & procurement contact.

Next steps proposed:
- You confirm approval owner and procurement contact (this week)
- Redwood to produce a first-pass pricing estimate and a targeted rollout plan (by Friday)
- Schedule procurement onboarding + security triage (30–45m)

Thanks — Alex
